exam: 2025年6月 第3套 · 仔细阅读 P1
title: Our society places a high value on physical beauty.…

sents.en: Our society places a high value on physical beauty.
sents.cn: 我们的社会高度重视外在美。

sents.en: Americans spend an average of over $722 each year on their appearance.
sents.cn: 美国人平均每年在容貌上花费超过722美元。

sents.en: One in ten Americans has tried to look like a star.
sents.cn: 每十个美国人中就有一个曾试图长得像明星。

sents.en: There·s nothing wrong with trying to look our best but excessive focus on physical appearance misses the soulful aspects of what it means to be beautiful.
sents.cn: 努力展现最好的一面并无不妥，但过度关注外貌，会错失美所蕴含的灵魂层面。

sents.en: Trying to look like the magazine pictures can take us on a long ride away from what beauty is really about.
sents.cn: 试图长得像杂志上的照片，会把我们带向远离美之本质的漫长弯路。

sents.en: Many of us spend far too much time, energy, and money trying to polish an image of what we think will bring attention, love, and connection.
sents.cn: 我们许多人花了太多时间、精力和金钱，去打磨一个自认为能带来关注、爱与连结的形象。

sents.en: In the process, we may fail to attend to ourselves in a way that would move us toward deeper intimacy, fulfillment, and meaning.
sents.cn: 在这一过程中，我们可能未能以某种方式关照自己，而那种方式本可带我们走向更深的亲密、满足与意义。

sents.en: It may sound trite (老生常谈的), but beauty is only skin deep; it’s not what brings love toward us.
sents.cn: 这话或许听起来是老生常谈（老生常谈的），但美只是肤浅的；它并不能将爱带向我们。

sents.en: Just read about the latest Hollywood starlets whose seeming love turns into resentment and bitter court battles.
sents.cn: 只需读读最近那些好莱坞小明星的故事：看似的爱情最终变成了怨恨与激烈的法庭争斗。

sents.en: Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing.
sents.cn: 外在美既可能是一种福分，也可能是一种诅咒。

sents.en: We may develop a habit of being so focused on maintaining a perfect appearance that we never cultivate the inner qualities necessary to sustain and deepen intimacy and connection.
sents.cn: 我们可能养成一种习惯，过于专注于维持完美外表，以至于从未培养维系并深化亲密与连结所需的内在品质。

sents.en: As I describe in my book, The Authentic Heart, it is the courage to be authentic that connects us in a deeper way.
sents.cn: 正如我在《本真之心》一书中所描述的，正是敢于真实的勇气，以一种更深的方式将我们彼此相连。

sents.en: While our initial attraction may be based in part on physical chemistry, it is the meeting of our inner worlds that creates the lasting intimacy and spiritual connection for which we long.
sents.cn: 尽管我们最初的吸引可能部分基于生理化学反应，但正是我们内心世界的相遇，创造出我们所渴望的持久亲密与精神连结。

sents.en: If we redirect our attention toward cultivating inner qualities, we might find a magnetic attraction that moves us from something superficial to something that connects us to our depths.
sents.cn: 如果我们把注意力转向培养内在品质，或许会发现一种磁石般的吸引力，将我们从肤浅之物引向连接我们深处之物。

sents.en: The path toward cultivating inner beauty is really simple.
sents.cn: 培养内在之美之路其实很简单。

sents.en: But what is simple is not always easy.
Not everyone will see us and appreciate us as we take the courageous risk to allow ourselves to be seen as we really are.
sents.cn: 当我们勇敢冒险、允许自己以真实面貌示人时，并非所有人都会看见并欣赏我们。

sents.en: But if they don·t it is their loss, not ours.
sents.cn: 但如果他们不欣赏，那是他们的损失，不是我们的。

sents.en: Eventually we·ll find those compatible souls who appreciate us as we are.
sents.cn: 我们终将找到那些懂得欣赏真实我们的、灵魂相契的人。
